title: path-owners.json
description: rbtv's per-user record of the commands it placed on PATH, at ~/.rbtv/path-owners.json, and which installations own each one. Written and read only by rbtv.

schema.description: The version of this record's format.

links.description: Each command on PATH, keyed by its name.

target.description: The absolute path of the program the command runs.

owners.description: The absolute paths of the installations that installed the command. The command is removed only when its last owner uninstalls it.
